skill.description: Analyze public WeChat Channels profiles and recent videos through SocialDataX using a work link, shared text, or known user ID.

security_audit.summary: Two command blocks automatically execute an unpinned npm package, creating supply-chain exposure with access to the API credential and local permissions. The other 40 detections concern Markdown syntax, legitimate service links, credential documentation, account identifiers, or readable Chinese text. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration instructions, destructive operations, or encoded payloads in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Both CLI examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y without a reviewed version or integrity lock.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and install through a lockfile with verified integrity. Obtain execution approval and restrict runtime credentials and filesystem access.

content.value_statement: Public profile details and recent videos need a consistent structure for account reviews. This skill guides SocialDataX retrieval and turns returned evidence into content themes, performance comparisons, and test recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Guide public profile and recent-video retrieval from a work link, shared text, or known WeChat Channels user ID.
Use documented CLI commands or existing MCP tools, with a default sample of 30 days and 50 videos.
Organize returned profile fields, video descriptions, publication times, public engagement metrics, and content identifiers.
Group sampled videos into content themes and assess posting frequency when timestamps are available.
Compare visible engagement differences and propose three to five evidence-based content tests.
Preserve partial results and guide pagination recovery without exceeding the original retrieval limits.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key and sufficient service balance; CLI execution also requires Node.js, npm, and package access.
Cannot identify accounts from a display name alone or guarantee complete historical coverage.
Cannot infer unavailable audience demographics, completion rates, recommendation traffic, account weights, or private data.
Provides read-only analysis and recommendations, without login, publishing, account changes, or guaranteed growth.

use_cases.title: Review a creator account
use_cases.description: Review recent themes, posting consistency, and visible engagement to select the next content experiments.

use_cases.title: Prepare a client account review
use_cases.description: Build a structured report that separates public account facts, sampled videos, and evidence-backed recommendations.

use_cases.title: Evaluate content categories
use_cases.description: Group a brand account's returned videos by theme or product line and compare visible engagement within the sample.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize an account
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this WeChat Channels work link: [link]. Summarize public account details and the default recent-video sample. Mark unavailable fields.

prompt_templates.title: Review recent content
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this shared text: [share text]. Review up to 50 videos from the past 30 days. Group themes and compare visible engagement.

prompt_templates.title: Design content experiments
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze user ID [user ID] over [days] days, capped at [count] videos. Separate facts from judgments. Propose five tests with supporting video evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Resume an incomplete review
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume this partial result: [result]. Preserve existing items and errors. Continue only with its nonempty next-page token and remaining limits. Report coverage gaps.

output_examples.input: Illustrative supplied sample: 12 videos from 30 days, including eight tutorials and four announcements. Summarize the themes.
output: Coverage: 12 supplied videos from the stated 30-day window.
Content themes: eight tutorials and four announcements.
Posting cadence: not assessed because publication timestamps were not supplied.
Engagement comparison: unavailable because no public interaction metrics were supplied.

output_examples.input: Illustrative supplied sample: tutorials have more visible interactions than announcements. Suggest next steps without claiming a growth cause.
output: Observed signal: tutorials show higher visible interaction counts within the supplied sample.
Interpretation: this difference does not establish a cause or predict future growth.
Test 1: compare two tutorial openings on similar topics.
Test 2: compare a tutorial and an announcement addressing the same audience need.
Test 3: repeat one tutorial format and compare returned public interaction metrics.

best_practices: Provide a complete work link, shared text, or known user ID, and specify the desired time window and sample limit.
Keep credentials in the configured environment, approve package execution, and prefer reviewed, pinned dependencies.
Separate returned facts from interpretation, cite representative videos, and preserve missing-field and partial-result warnings.
anti_patterns: Requesting account discovery from a display name alone or treating the default sample as complete history.
Inventing missing metrics, audience attributes, platform explanations, or guaranteed growth outcomes.
Concatenating raw shared text into shell commands or repeatedly retrying balance failures and incomplete queries from the first page.

faq.question: Which inputs are supported?
faq.answer: Provide a WeChat Channels work link, shared text, or known user ID. An account display name alone is not supported.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and ensure sufficient service balance. Use Node.js and npm for CLI execution, or an existing compatible MCP connection.

faq.question: How many videos are reviewed?
faq.answer: The default is up to 50 videos from the past 30 days. You can request another range or limit, subject to returned coverage.

faq.question: Can it publish or change my account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only. It excludes login, posting, likes, comments, private messages, and account modifications.

faq.question: Does it reveal private analytics or predict growth?
faq.answer: No. Analysis uses returned public fields and visible interactions. It does not supply missing private analytics or guarantee growth.

faq.question: What happens after an incomplete response?
faq.answer: Keep retrieved items and errors. Resume only with a nonempty continuation token and remaining limits; otherwise report the gap without automatically restarting.
